about: Common school / hobby electronics parts for the Assist app's Electronics mode. 're' is matched against the marking with spaces and punctuation removed, in capitals. 'pins' are in pin-number order. DIP: pin 1 is beside the notch/dot, counting anticlockwise seen from above. TO-92: flat face towards you, legs down, left to right. TO-220: printed face towards you, legs down, left to right. '~' in front of a pin name means active-low. '{1}' in a text is replaced by the first bracketed group of 're'. Check the maker's datasheet before relying on a pinout: second-source parts occasionally differ.

parts.name: 555 timer
parts.about: Timer and oscillator: blinkers, delays, tones, PWM.
parts.tip: Tie ~RESET (pin 4) to VCC if unused. Put 10 nF from CTRL (pin 5) to ground.

parts.name: 741 op-amp
parts.about: Classic single op-amp.
parts.tip: Output cannot reach the supply rails; not suitable for 5 V single-supply circuits.

parts.name: LM358 dual op-amp
parts.about: Two op-amps that work from a single supply; inputs and output go down to ground.
parts.tip: Output only reaches about V+ minus 1.5 V.

parts.name: TL072 / TL082 dual op-amp
parts.about: Low-noise JFET-input dual op-amp, common in audio.
parts.tip: Needs a split supply (or a virtual ground at half supply).

parts.name: NE5532 dual audio op-amp
parts.about: Low-noise dual op-amp for audio.
parts.tip: Needs a split supply.

parts.name: LM393 dual comparator
parts.about: Two voltage comparators.
parts.tip: Outputs are open-collector: add a pull-up resistor (about 10 k) to each output.

parts.name: LM386 audio amplifier
parts.about: Small speaker amplifier, gain 20 to 200.
parts.tip: 10 uF between pins 1 and 8 sets gain to 200. Output needs a series capacitor (about 220 uF) to the speaker.

parts.name: LM311 comparator
parts.about: Single fast comparator.
parts.tip: Open-collector output: add a pull-up resistor.

parts.name: ATtiny25/45/85 microcontroller
parts.about: 8-pin AVR microcontroller.
parts.tip: Put 100 nF between VCC and GND close to the chip.

parts.name: 24Cxx I2C EEPROM
parts.about: Serial memory on the I2C bus.
parts.tip: SDA and SCL need pull-ups (about 4.7 k). Tie WP to ground to allow writing.

parts.name: DS1307 real-time clock
parts.about: Clock and calendar on the I2C bus.
parts.tip: Needs a 32.768 kHz crystal on pins 1-2 and a 3 V coin cell on VBAT.

parts.name: PC817 optocoupler
parts.about: LED plus phototransistor: passes a signal with no electrical connection.
parts.tip: The LED side needs a series resistor.

parts.name: 4N25-4N37 optocoupler
parts.about: LED plus phototransistor for isolation.
parts.tip: Leave BASE (pin 6) unconnected in most circuits.

parts.name: LM324 quad op-amp
parts.about: Four single-supply op-amps.
parts.tip: Power is on pins 4 (V+) and 11 (GND), not the corners.

parts.name: TL074 / TL084 quad op-amp
parts.about: Four JFET-input op-amps.
parts.tip: Power is on pins 4 (V+) and 11 (V-).

parts.name: LM339 quad comparator
parts.about: Four comparators.
parts.tip: Open-collector outputs: each needs a pull-up resistor.

parts.name: 74xx00 quad NAND gate
parts.about: Four 2-input NAND gates.
parts.tip: Tie unused inputs to VCC or GND; never leave CMOS inputs floating.

parts.name: 74xx02 quad NOR gate
parts.about: Four 2-input NOR gates.
parts.tip: Careful: the outputs come first on this chip, unlike the 7400.

parts.name: 74xx04 hex inverter
parts.about: Six NOT gates.
parts.tip: Tie unused inputs to VCC or GND.

parts.name: 74xx14 hex Schmitt inverter
parts.about: Six NOT gates with Schmitt-trigger inputs: clean up slow or noisy signals.
parts.tip: Good for debouncing a switch with a resistor and capacitor.

parts.name: 74xx08 quad AND gate
parts.about: Four 2-input AND gates.
parts.tip: Tie unused inputs to VCC or GND.

parts.name: 74xx32 quad OR gate
parts.about: Four 2-input OR gates.
parts.tip: Tie unused inputs to VCC or GND.

parts.name: 74xx86 quad XOR gate
parts.about: Four 2-input exclusive-OR gates.
parts.tip: Tie unused inputs to VCC or GND.

parts.name: 74xx74 dual D flip-flop
parts.about: Two D-type flip-flops with preset and clear.
parts.tip: Tie ~PRE and ~CLR to VCC when unused.

parts.name: 74xx164 shift register (serial in, parallel out)
parts.about: 8-bit shift register.
parts.tip: Data in is A AND B: tie the spare one to VCC.

parts.name: CD4001 quad NOR gate
parts.about: Four 2-input NOR gates (CMOS).
parts.tip: Static-sensitive. Tie unused inputs to VDD or VSS.

parts.name: CD4011 quad NAND gate
parts.about: Four 2-input NAND gates (CMOS).
parts.tip: Pin layout differs from the 7400. Tie unused inputs to VDD or VSS.

parts.name: CD4071 quad OR gate
parts.about: Four 2-input OR gates (CMOS).
parts.tip: Tie unused inputs to VDD or VSS.

parts.name: CD4081 quad AND gate
parts.about: Four 2-input AND gates (CMOS).
parts.tip: Tie unused inputs to VDD or VSS.

parts.name: CD4093 quad Schmitt NAND gate
parts.about: Four NAND gates with Schmitt-trigger inputs; makes simple oscillators.
parts.tip: Tie unused inputs to VDD or VSS.

parts.name: CD4013 dual D flip-flop
parts.about: Two D-type flip-flops (CMOS).
parts.tip: Tie SET and RESET to VSS when unused (they are active-high).

parts.name: 74xx595 shift register with output latch
parts.about: Turns 3 microcontroller pins into 8 outputs; chains for more.
parts.tip: Tie ~OE to GND and ~SRCLR to VCC. QA is on pin 15, away from the others.

parts.name: 74xx138 3-to-8 decoder
parts.about: Selects one of eight active-low outputs from a 3-bit address.
parts.tip: Enabled only when G1 is high and both ~G2 inputs are low.

parts.name: 74xx165 shift register (parallel in, serial out)
parts.about: Reads 8 switches with 3 microcontroller pins.
parts.tip: Tie CLK INH to GND.

parts.name: CD4017 decade counter
parts.about: Counts clock pulses and lights one of ten outputs in turn (LED chasers).
parts.tip: Tie CLOCK ENABLE (13) and RESET (15) to VSS for normal counting. The outputs are not in pin order.

parts.name: 4051 8-channel analogue multiplexer
parts.about: Connects one of eight signals to a common pin: read 8 sensors with one analogue input.
parts.tip: Tie INHIBIT to ground, and VEE to ground for single-supply use.

parts.name: CD4060 counter with oscillator
parts.about: 14-stage binary divider with a built-in oscillator: long timers from one chip.
parts.tip: There are no Q1-Q3 or Q11 outputs. Tie RESET to VSS to run.

parts.name: CD4511 BCD to 7-segment driver
parts.about: Shows a binary number 0-9 on a common-cathode 7-segment display.
parts.tip: Tie ~LT and ~BL to VDD and LE to VSS. Each segment needs its own resistor.

parts.name: ULN2003 Darlington driver
parts.supply: loads up to 50 V, 500 mA each
parts.about: Seven switches to ground for relays, motors, lamps and stepper motors.
parts.tip: Connect COM (pin 9) to the load's positive supply so the built-in diodes protect against relay and motor kickback.

parts.name: L293D motor driver
parts.supply: logic 5 V; motors 4.5-36 V, 600 mA per channel
parts.about: Two H-bridges: drives two DC motors both ways, or one stepper.
parts.tip: Pin 16 is the 5 V logic supply and pin 8 the motor supply: do not swap them. The four GND pins also carry away heat.

parts.name: MAX232 RS-232 level shifter
parts.about: Converts 5 V logic serial to RS-232 voltages and back.
parts.tip: Needs four small capacitors (1 uF for MAX232, 100 nF for MAX232A).

parts.name: MCP3008 8-channel ADC
parts.about: Eight analogue inputs over SPI (popular with Raspberry Pi).
parts.tip: Connect VREF to VDD for a full-range reading.

parts.name: 74xx245 bus transceiver
parts.about: Eight two-way buffers.
parts.tip: DIR high sends A to B. Tie ~OE to GND to enable.

parts.name: 74xx573 8-bit latch
parts.about: Holds 8 bits while LE is low.
parts.tip: Tie ~OE to GND to enable the outputs.

parts.name: ATmega328P microcontroller (Arduino Uno chip)
parts.about: The microcontroller on the Arduino Uno. Arduino pin names are in brackets (~ after a number marks PWM).
parts.tip: Connect both VCC (7) and AVCC (20) to the supply, and both GND pins. 10 k from ~RESET to VCC.

parts.name: MCP23017 16-bit I/O expander
parts.about: Sixteen extra input/output pins over I2C.
parts.tip: Tie ~RESET to VDD and A0-A2 to GND or VDD to set the address.

parts.name: 78{1} positive voltage regulator
parts.supply: input at least 2-3 V above the output, up to 35 V
parts.about: Fixed {1} V regulator, up to 1 A.
parts.tip: Put capacitors on input (330 nF) and output (100 nF). Gets hot: add a heatsink for more than a few hundred mA. The metal tab is GND.

parts.name: 79{1} negative voltage regulator
parts.supply: negative input, at least 2-3 V beyond the output
parts.about: Fixed -{1} V regulator.
parts.tip: The pin order is NOT the same as the 78xx, and the metal tab is the INPUT, not ground.

parts.name: LM317 adjustable regulator
parts.supply: input up to 40 V; output 1.25-37 V
parts.about: Adjustable regulator, up to 1.5 A.
parts.tip: Vout = 1.25 V x (1 + R2/R1), with R1 (about 240 ohm) between OUT and ADJ. The metal tab is OUT.

parts.name: LM1117T regulator (TO-220)
parts.supply: input up to 15 V; needs about 1.2 V of headroom
parts.about: Low-dropout regulator (3.3 V and 5 V versions are common), up to 800 mA.
parts.tip: Needs the output capacitor specified by the datasheet. The tab is OUT. This diagram is only for LM1117T in TO-220; other 1117 packages are not covered.

parts.name: IRF power MOSFET
parts.about: Power MOSFET switch.
parts.tip: IRF types need about 10 V on the gate to turn on fully; use a logic-level type (IRL, IRLZ) from 5 V or 3.3 V. Static-sensitive. The tab is DRAIN.

parts.name: TIP power transistor
parts.about: Power transistor (TIP120-127 are Darlingtons with high gain).
parts.tip: Needs a base resistor. The tab is COLLECTOR. Add a diode across motors and relays.

parts.name: 2N3904 / 2N3906 transistor
parts.supply: 40 V collector-emitter, 200 mA absolute maximum; derate in use
parts.about: General-purpose transistor: 2N3904 is NPN; 2N3906 is PNP. This pinout is for their TO-92 package.
parts.tip: Use a base resistor sized for the circuit. Do not apply this pinout to 2N2222 or other similarly named transistors; verify the exact maker and package.

parts.name: Small transistor (BC547 family)
parts.about: General-purpose transistor. BC546-550 and BC337 are NPN; BC556-560 and BC327 are PNP.
parts.tip: The legs are the other way round from the 2N3904 family. Use a base resistor.

parts.name: 2N7000 small MOSFET
parts.about: Small N-channel MOSFET switch, works from 5 V logic.
parts.tip: Static-sensitive.

parts.name: BS170 small MOSFET
parts.about: Small N-channel MOSFET switch.
parts.tip: Pin order is the reverse of the 2N7000.

parts.name: 78L{1} small voltage regulator
parts.about: Fixed {1} V regulator, up to 100 mA.
parts.tip: The pin order is the mirror image of the big 78xx in a TO-220.

parts.name: LM35 temperature sensor
parts.about: Outputs 10 mV per degree Celsius.
parts.tip: Fitted backwards it gets very hot very quickly: check before powering.

parts.name: TMP36 temperature sensor
parts.about: Outputs 10 mV per degree Celsius with a 500 mV offset (750 mV at 25 C).
parts.tip: Fitted backwards it gets hot: check before powering.

parts.name: DS18B20 digital temperature sensor
parts.about: Digital temperature sensor on a one-wire bus.
parts.tip: Needs a 4.7 k pull-up from DQ to VDD.
